summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for the new Social Solidarity membership scope: module split (الحسابات/العضوية), membership create/search/report/retirement filters/current-size flows, org isolation, and auth playbook checks. Most requested flows passed end-to-end; one critical public CORS preflight issue persists.

critical.issue: Public preflight response still returns access-control-allow-origin='*' and does not expose access-control-allow-credentials=true instead of explicit allowed origin with credentials for auth flow.

issues: Birth date field uses browser native date input (default picker) instead of a consistent custom calendar component.

action_items: Fix edge/ingress handling for auth preflight to return explicit origin (not '*') and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true.
Re-validate CORS from public URL after edge fix using browser preflight and automated test.
Optionally standardize membership birth-date UX with app-wide calendar component.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains a large monolith (>4500 LOC), which raises regression risk for cross-module changes.
Auth seed logic updates existing admin password hash when ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes (idempotent behavior observed in code path).
bcrypt hashing path is active and persisted admin hashes follow $2b$ prefix.
Egyptian e-invoice authority submission remains MOCKED/internal and was not part of this membership scope validation.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used social-solidarity admin_takaful/Admin@123 (fallback admin/Admin@123) and general-union admin_union/Admin@123.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary membership records via API/UI (prefixes TEST_MEMBER_/UI_MEMBER_). No delete endpoint exists for membership, so records remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core membership flows are passing in UI and API. General-union behavior is: membership card hidden and direct /membership route redirects to home. Module toggle membership false/restore tested via /api/admin/organization/modules. Remaining blocker is public CORS preflight mismatch.
rca of the issue: RCA (CORS): backend includes CORSMiddleware + explicit preflight middleware that should return explicit origin/credentials, but public OPTIONS response is still wildcard. This strongly indicates ingress/edge layer is overriding backend CORS headers before reaching client. Mitigation: enforce CORS policy at ingress/proxy layer to mirror backend credentialed origin policy.
